issue: DistantHorizonsStandalone #56 - Screen is Black and then Crashes when Angelica isn't Present

findings.summary: Black screen followed by crash when Angelica mod is not installed. RenderHelper.java handles both Angelica and non-Angelica code paths, but the non-Angelica path may have OpenGL state management issues.
findings.root_cause: RenderHelper.drawLods() and drawLodsFade() manipulate OpenGL state (GL_ALPHA_TEST, GL_BLEND) differently when Angelica is absent. The GL_CLEAR_COLOR with alpha 0 and disable/enable of alpha test may cause framebuffer issues on some GPUs/drivers.
evidence: RenderHelper.java:22-37: drawLods() disables GL_ALPHA_TEST when angelicaCompat == null
RenderHelper.java:28: GL11.glClearColor(1, 1, 1, 0.0F) - clears with transparent white
RenderHelper.java:46: drawDeferredLods() returns early if angelicaCompat == null - this is a problem
GLProxy.java:124-134: Crashes if OpenGL 3.2 not supported - but error message would be clear
ForgeMain.java:40: dependencies = 'after:angelica;' - Angelica is optional dependency

primary.issue: OpenGL state manipulation without Angelica may cause black screen on some systems
Early return when Angelica absent - deferred rendering completely disabled

related.note: OpenGL version check - may be related if GPU doesn't support required features

gap_analysis.current_behavior: Non-Angelica rendering path modifies OpenGL state (alpha test, clear color) which may conflict with vanilla MC rendering
gap_analysis.required_behavior: Non-Angelica path should preserve OpenGL state better or use different rendering approach
gap_analysis.invariant_violated: OpenGL state consistency between vanilla and mod rendering

proposed_fix.approach: Save and restore complete OpenGL state in drawLods(), or add config option to disable problematic rendering when Angelica absent
implementation_steps: 1. Save all modified OpenGL state before changes in drawLods()
2. Restore state after rendering instead of partial restoration
3. Add config option to disable DH rendering if Angelica not present
4. Consider forcing Angelica as required dependency for rendering features
proposed_fix.code_changes: Save/restore GL state; add null-Angelica safety mode

falsification_test.description: If black screen persists after GL state fix, issue is in shader/program usage without Angelica
steps: 1. Test with GL state fix applied
2. If still black screen, check GLProxy shader program compilation
4. If no black screen without rendering, issue confirmed in RenderHelper

confidence_reason: Clear code path identified: non-Angelica rendering manipulates GL state differently. Pattern matches common OpenGL modding issues.
